title: 75-2 面面圆角的两张正交支撑面
current_evidence_scope: 注意：这里先对重建面片做了缝合/裁剪/延伸，再执行普通圆角；原始重建模型保留在中栏。OCC 实际圆角 · R = 1 mm · 部分未通过。原图特殊模式尚未验证；选边与外形待人工核对。

generic_oracles.quantity: support geometry + finite domains + topology class
generic_oracles.method: Compare independently sampled supports/boundaries, dimensions, placements and material-side occupancy; account for allowed face subdivision. No widening, thickening or pruning source faces.

generic_oracles.expected: exactly requested faces/edges, no silent reselection
generic_oracles.method: Resolve geometric/topological selectors after import; record candidates and expected match count; ambiguous target stops score.
Native checks plus independent seam and occupancy/orientation tests. Save raw BRep even on failure.
Evaluate shared edge and both support surfaces using actual pcurves; sample endpoints/interior and adaptive extrema.
Use consistent material/sheet orientation and evaluate normals at actual seam; end caps only exempt from G1 if declared, never from G0.

target_change: A: generate a real face-face transition between the supplied orthogonal walls; expose independent choice of section-plane/contact/shape properties.
B: compare explicit-wall-only propagation against continuation onto adjacent boss faces; retain both source input components.
must_preserve: A walls remain zero-thickness sheets; green cross-sectional plane is auxiliary only.
B boss remains a solid and floor remains a sheet unless a separately frozen preparation recipe is declared; do not quietly remove boss bottom and score that as original input.
Same base supports/dimensions across mode comparisons; do not collapse the whole concept to ordinary R1.

semantic_target.A: vertical plane y=0 and horizontal z=0, local x[-12,12], walls height18/floor16, group placement x=-20
semantic_target.B: boss footprint x[-6,6], y[-5,5], z[0,14] with floor x[-13,13],y[-12,12],z0, group placement x=+20; choose the declared boss-wall/floor pair and adjacent propagation faces, not all four roots by default

required_modes.expected: blend rail stays on explicitly selected walls
blend continues onto declared adjacent faces

feature_oracles.method: Take actual plane sections at 11 longitudinal stations, verify support tangency and radius/conic/G2 as requested; never count a drawn green plane as a result.

feature_oracles.expected: explicit-only excludes adjacent walls; propagate mode reaches the expected neighboring walls
